headline: Congress named a post office in Oxnard, California, after John R. Hatcher III.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1961 North C Street in Oxnard, California, as the John R. Hatcher III Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, rules, or staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on December 27, 2022.
